propositions: transport.py exceeds 799 lines and blocks further capability work; previous reactive splits did not establish a stable module organization principle

The module's natural boundaries are the capability Protocols already defined in _backend.py (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe), which should serve as the organizing seam for splitting

A mixin-based relocation along capability boundaries will move code without changing call sites or breaking Protocol conformance, allowing each new operation to have a determined home based on capability rather than available headroom
The split must result in six modules each between 100-500 LOC, above the policy floor and below the 800 cap, preserving _resolve_epic_link_field_id as a single definition
All tests must pass untouched, JiraDataCenterTransport must remain a single class, and the __all__ facade must resolve every currently re-exported name without edits
A docstring statement of the organizing principle (one module per capability Protocol) must guide future operations to their correct destination module
